message: Expected path '/health' to start with base path '/v1' (x-fern-base-path sets paths-include-base-path: true). Fern leaves this path unchanged and still prepends the base path, so SDKs call '/v1/health'.

Expected path '/v2/pets' to start with base path '/v1' (x-fern-base-path sets paths-include-base-path: true). Fern leaves this path unchanged and still prepends the base path, so SDKs call '/v1/v2/pets'.
